nom: La Roche-Posay Vitamin C Brightening Facial Cleanser

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report the cleanser does not strip or tighten their skin and leaves it soft, though a few describe extreme dry patches or needing to follow with a rich moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including those sensitive to vitamin C or fragrance, mostly describe it as gentle, soothing, and non-irritating with no stinging.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances an oily T-zone while keeping the rest of the face comfortable, with one noting improved texture and reduced spots over eight weeks.
segments.mature: A reviewer with mature, dull, combo skin reports visible brightening with consistent use, without tightness or stripping.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes the cleanser helps control oil and breakouts, though another mentions it occasionally leaves skin feeling a little oily.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer identifying as mature/dull-skinned reports visible brightening and no tightness with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without drying or stripping the skin, but several report dryness, tightness, or dry patches, especially with daily/primary use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers describe it as calming and non-irritating, with one noting no stinging and another highlighting its soothing effect on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with easily irritated or barrier-compromised skin cite niacinamide, ceramides, and thermal spring water as reasons it feels calming rather than compromising, though a couple still found it too drying for daily solo use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a reduction in dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or sun damage after weeks of consistent use, though results are described as gradual and requiring consistency.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in acne-prone or combination skin, but a few explicitly report new breakouts or increased pimples during use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says it helps control oil and breakouts, while another notes the product occasionally leaves skin feeling slightly oily.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way, good value
Does not remove makeup or mascara well

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this face wash, but I didn't. I didn't like the way it left my skin feeling, it felt stripped and dry. It didn't do a very good job at cleaning either. I haven't broke out in years, but this changed all that for me. The only thing it had going for it was it smelled pleasant. I would not purchase this again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging is so sleek and simple I do love it. My skin tends to be more on the dry side with an oily T-zone. I will say I love the feel and way my face feels after washing. I will say I've been using for about a week going on 2 and I'm having some extreme dry patches around my chin and neck as well as sides of my face. I would keep that in mind if you also tend to have dry skin.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review.This cleanser is very gentle on your face and makes your skin feel very soothed afterwards. However, I haven't noticed a difference in my skin completely. You'd have to use it for a month to see any brightening effect. There isn't too much of a scent; a low fragrance level is great for cleansers. Overall, great product for anyone with sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I struggle with dark spots and sun damage on my skin. I have been using this product for about 2 months, and the change is noticeable. My skin looks brighter and great without makeup. The cleanser lathers really well. I love the fact that I only need a small drop to wash my face, which means my product will last forever. The best thing for me, though, is the scent. It isn't the usual chemical citrus smell but the most calming and refreshing scent I have ever smelled. I am very happy I was sent this product to try in exchange for my honest review. It will now be a staple in my skin care routine.

I received this product for free for my review Where has this been all my life? I am a 36 year old female who has struggled with my skin my entire life. Nothing horrible, but just dull, combination, acne prone skin. When I started this wash I didn't expect much. I do regular professional facials, derma-planing, chemical peels, sulfuric face washes, salicylic acid etc.Basically you name it, I've tried. I've been using this face wash daily for 8ish weeks and my skin finally looks healthy. My texture has improved significantly. My combination skin is more even. I've even noticed a reduction in the occasional spot. I love that this face wash is thick (like a hand soap consistency) and has nearly no scent. I will, without a doubt be purchasing this regularly. It is worth every penny.

extraits.titre: A Must for Mature Dull Skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin is loving the La Roche-Posay Vitamin C Brightening Skin Cleanser. I have mature combo skin and even with sunscreen I still wind up getting some sun on my face living in Florida. Using this consistently has definitely brightened up my skin. I love that it doesn't leave your face feeling tight and stripped, rather you feel refreshed and your skin is glowing.
